title: AI-Augmented Data Engineering Roadmap
description: A 6-month Markdown-first learning platform for core data engineering and AI-native workflows.
text: AI Augmented Data Engineering Roadmap Core knowledge is not removed. It is solidified first. AI is then added in the right places to augment, not replace, the data engineering workflow. This platform is designed as a learning system, not just a list of tutorials. Each phase builds the foundation for the next phase, and each project reuses the output of the previous project.

title: Project 1 - Core Analytics Warehouse
description: Build the warehouse foundation for later AI analytics projects.
text: Project 1 Core Analytics Warehouse Goal Build a clean analytics warehouse from raw data to staging models and business marts. Architecture Deliverables Source data contracts Staging models Dimensional marts dbt tests dbt documentation Data quality report Output used by next project Project 2 uses these marts as the trusted SQL layer for Text2SQL.

title: Project 2 - Text2SQL Chatbot
description: Build a chatbot that converts business questions into validated SQL.
text: Project 2 Text2SQL Chatbot Goal Build a chatbot that allows users to ask business questions in natural language and receive SQL backed answers. Why this matters Text2SQL is not just about generating SQL. It requires correct business logic, trusted metrics, semantic definitions, and validation. Architecture Deliverables Semantic metric definitions Prompt templates SQL validator Evaluation question set Web UI or Streamlit UI Error analysis report

title: Project 3 - RAG for Internal Data Docs
description: Build an assistant that answers questions from docs, schema, and glossary.
text: Project 3 RAG for Internal Data Docs Goal Build a RAG assistant over Markdown documentation, dbt docs, schema notes, and business glossary. Architecture Deliverables Document parser Chunking strategy Vector index Retrieval API Grounded answer UI Evaluation examples

title: Project 4 - LLM Extraction Pipeline
description: Extract structured records from unstructured sources with validation.
text: Project 4 LLM Extraction Pipeline Goal Extract structured records from PDFs, emails, text files, and semi structured notes. Pipeline Deliverables Extraction schema Parser job Validation layer Error queue Review report

title: Project 5 - AI Data Platform
description: Combine warehouse, Text2SQL, RAG, extraction, monitoring, and docs.
text: Project 5 AI Data Platform Goal Combine the previous projects into one portfolio grade AI data platform. Components Static learning docs website Analytics warehouse Text2SQL chatbot RAG knowledge assistant LLM extraction pipeline Monitoring dashboard Project documentation Final outcome A portfolio platform that demonstrates both core Data Engineering and practical AI augmentation.

title: Phase 1 - Core Foundation
description: Month 1-2 focus on the core skills that AI cannot replace.
text: Phase 1 Core Foundation Phase 1 is about becoming technically solid before relying on AI. AI can speed up coding, but it cannot replace your understanding of data quality, modeling, orchestration, and debugging. Focus areas Area Outcome SQL Advanced Window functions, CTEs, query optimization, analytical patterns Python File processing, API calls, data validation, automation scripts dbt Staging, marts, tests, documentation, lineage Airflow DAG design, retries, dependencies, scheduling Cloud Object storage, managed database, basic IAM, deployment Deliverable Build Project 1: Core Analytics Warehouse.

title: Phase 2 - Modern Analytics + AI Bridge
description: Month 3-4 connect modern analytics stack with AI analytics patterns.
text: Phase 2 Modern Analytics + AI Bridge Phase 2 focuses on the bridge between traditional data engineering and AI analytics. Why semantic layer matters Text2SQL is risky when the LLM does not understand business definitions. A semantic layer gives the model controlled metric definitions, entities, dimensions, and join paths. Focus areas Modern Analytics Stack Metrics layer and business glossary Semantic model design Text2SQL prompt patterns SQL validation and guardrails Evaluation datasets for analytics questions Deliverable Build Project 2: Text2SQL Chatbot.

title: Phase 3 - AI-Native Workflows
description: Month 5-6 apply RAG, extraction, and AI-assisted coding to daily data work.
text: Phase 3 AI Native Workflows Phase 3 adds AI to real workflows: documentation search, unstructured extraction, code generation, test generation, and incident investigation. Focus areas RAG over internal documentation LLM extraction from PDFs, emails, and semi structured text Evaluation and guardrails AI assisted coding workflow Monitoring and human review loops Deliverable Build Projects 3, 4, and 5.

title: Semantic Layer
description: Control business logic so humans and LLMs query metrics consistently.
text: Semantic Layer A semantic layer defines trusted business entities, dimensions, metrics, and relationships. Why it matters for LLMs LLMs can generate SQL, but they need controlled context. Without a semantic layer, the model may use the wrong table, wrong join path, or wrong metric definition. Example metric definition

title: Python for Data Pipelines
description: Use Python for extraction, validation, orchestration helpers, and automation.
text: Python for Data Pipelines Python is used to glue systems together: APIs, files, validation, batch jobs, and orchestration. Starter pattern Production mindset Good Python pipeline code should have logging, validation, retries, tests, and clear error messages.

title: SQL Window Functions
description: Learn ranking, running totals, lag/lead, and analytical SQL patterns.
text: SQL Window Functions Window functions allow you to calculate values across related rows while keeping row level detail. Common patterns Why it matters Most analytics engineering work depends on understanding grain, partitions, ordering, and business metric logic.

title: Text2SQL Patterns
description: Convert business questions into validated SQL with guardrails.
text: Text2SQL Patterns Text2SQL is not only prompt engineering. It is a system design problem. Recommended flow Guardrails Only allow SELECT queries. Limit scanned tables. Validate columns and joins. Compare generated SQL against known examples. Store failed questions for evaluation.

title: SQL Query Optimization
description: Practical performance patterns for analytical queries.
text: SQL Query Optimization Optimization starts with understanding data volume, join cardinality, indexes, partitions, and query plans. Checklist Filter early when possible. Avoid accidental many to many joins. Check table grain before joining. Use partitions or clustering for large fact tables. Materialize repeated transformations.

title: RAG Pipeline for Internal Data
description: Build retrieval augmented generation over docs, schema, and business glossary.
text: RAG Pipeline for Internal Data RAG helps answer questions using internal documentation, data dictionary, schemas, and project notes. Pipeline What to index Data dictionary dbt model docs Business glossary Pipeline runbooks Incident notes
